tasks.spec:
You are changing one generic engine behavior and reverting one data edit in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: storygame/runtime/recent_cue.py (and the smallest change needed in storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py ~line 461 if its call needs another argument), data/stories/continuity-initiative/knowledge.yaml (ONLY the third action_evidence group of k_sl_1a_b_r0 and k_sl_1a_b_r0w), tests/test_recent_cue_reference.py, tests/test_recent_cue_unit.py, tests/test_1a_back_door_gap.py, tests/test_1a_witnessed_recovery.py. Do not edit docs/testing-runbook.md, other data, bench/frozen, or reformat unrelated text. Shared runtime has NO story names (no drawer, gap, Kristin, card, 1A).

BACKGROUND. The project pins this design: a bare 'Search the gap.' with NO prior cue earns nothing (tests/test_recent_cue_reference.py::test_gap_without_prior_cue_earns_nothing), while a gap follow-up right after a turn that committed a reveal whose delivery text mentions the gap does earn the card, because storygame/runtime/recent_cue.py `recent_cue_referent_text` derives a short-lived referent (the reveal's single non-protagonist owner entity) from the last accepted turn's `reveal_ids`. An earlier edit of mine added the phrases `the gap` and `that gap` to the third action_evidence group of k_sl_1a_b_r0 (and the copy in k_sl_1a_b_r0w); that BREAKS the pinned design above. REVERT that: the third group of both items must be exactly [drawer, KMS, workstation, "drawer's"] again.

MEASURED PROBLEM (live, 5 of 5 playthroughs). In scene 1A the first turn shows the player a STAGED CUE (a package `cue_text` on a fact delivery, data/stories/continuity-initiative/handoffs.yaml, fact continuity_initiative_known, whose text ends 'A thin gap beneath its lower edge is wide enough for Kristin's fingers.'). It is appended to the narration but no reveal is committed on that turn, so `record.reveal_ids` is empty and `recent_cue_referent_text` returns nothing. The player then types 'Feel in the gap.' and gets no reveal; the narrator invents a door gap. The cue DID present the gap, so 'the gap' should resolve to the thing the cue is about, for that next turn only.

REQUIRED CHANGE (generic). Extend `recent_cue_referent_text` so that, in addition to the committed-reveal path, a cue delivered on the immediately preceding accepted turn of the current scene visit also supplies a referent. Look at how a delivered cue is recorded (state.cue_stages entries with fact_id, stage, last_turn, visit_entered_at; state.delivered_cue_ids; RuntimeEngine._complete_accepted_turn in storygame/runtime/engine.py sets them with last_turn=state.turn_index) and at package.deliveries (FactDelivery.cue_text / escalation_text, costs). Use ONLY typed package data, no regex on prose beyond the existing content-word overlap helper: the cue text of a cue whose cue_stages.last_turn equals the last accepted turn supplies the words; the owner is the single non-protagonist entity named by the entity_ids of the reveal(s) in the package knowledge that establish the cue's fact OR any fact asserted by that delivery's `costs` (here memory_card_recovered -> k_sl_1a_b_r0, owner michelle_drawer; ignore protagonist and ignore entities the player's command already names, exactly as the reveal path does). The same overlap rule applies: the player's content words must overlap the cue words. If more than one distinct owner remains, return '' (ambiguous). The referent must expire exactly like the reveal path (one turn; not across a scene change; not after an unrelated accepted turn; not after a snapshot restore to before the cue). Keep one function, no duplication of the existing logic: refactor to share the owner and overlap code.

TESTS FIRST. In tests/test_recent_cue_reference.py and tests/test_recent_cue_unit.py add, small and complete, using the real engine with the stubbed worker as the file already does: (1) after the first turn 'Go in the house.' (the scene's staged cue is delivered, no reveal committed; verify in the test that the cue text appears in that turn's narration) 'Feel in the gap.' and 'Search the gap.' select k_sl_1a_b_r0, for both FREYTAG_SEMANTIC_REVEAL 0 and 1; (2) the pinned negatives still pass unchanged: bare gap with no prior turn earns nothing, an unrelated follow-up ('Read the receipt.') does not use the cue, 'Search the kitchen.' does not resolve to the drawer; (3) the cue referent expires: after the cue turn plus one unrelated accepted turn ('Search the kitchen.'), 'Feel in the gap.' earns nothing; (4) when the cue was delivered but the card is already recovered, nothing is selected (existing eligibility). (5) Update tests/test_1a_back_door_gap.py and tests/test_1a_witnessed_recovery.py: anything that asserted the PURE matcher alone matches 'Feel in the gap.' / 'the gap' must now assert the engine-level behavior from (1) instead, or be removed if it duplicates it. Existing tests that still pass must not be weakened.

FINISH: ruff format and ruff check every .py you touched; run the focused suites in the check; report which old assertions you changed and why.
